title: Negative Reputation w/ Sybil Resistance
tagline: A contract to aggregate negative reputation for any address. Sybil protection provided by WorldID
description:
- Negative feedback belongs on chain because there is no clear incentive for someone to distribute or platform negative posts about an address (inspired by Vitalik)
- negative feedback aggregation is vulnerable to being botted to bring down a users score. WC proof of humanity stops this
-
how_its_made:
The project uses for NextJs as the UI framework, TRPC for client-server communication, IPFS for storage of reviews, Worldcoin for Sybil resistance, and Polygon as the consensus layer.

This project would not have been possible without Worldcoin due to the Sybil resistance it provides. IPFS enabled us to use decentralized storage instead of centralized alternatives.
